name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, other than a tractor; an electric two-wheeler whose motor exceeds five brake horsepower (3,750 W) is a full motorcycle rather than a motor-driven cycle.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground (West Virginia Code §17C-1-4)
Its motor produces more than five brake horsepower (3,750 W); one at or under that is a motor-driven cycle

Riders need a motorcycle (F) endorsement or a Class F motorcycle-only license, earned with a knowledge test and an on-cycle skills test or a rider course; riders under 18 must first complete the Level II graduated license
Every rider and passenger must wear a fastened helmet meeting FMVSS 218, ANSI Z90.1 or Snell standards
Every rider and passenger must wear shatter-resistant safety glasses, goggles or a face shield
Handlebars or grips may be no more than 15 inches above the seat, and it needs a handlebar or fairing mirror showing 200 feet behind
Registered with the DMV as a Class G vehicle, with insurance information required at renewal
Off the highway, a motorcycle is ridden under the all-terrain vehicle rules instead
